title: Driving the apical compartment can create an illusory percept

statements.text: Optogenetic enhancement of apical activity made mice respond as if a whisker stimulus were present. The authors read these false alarms as a sign that the animal experienced an illusory stimulus, as humans do when they expect one.

sources.quote: Optogenetic enhancement of apical dendritic activity also led to false alarms.
A bold but highly plausible interpretation would be that the animal experienced an illusory stimulus
